description: This file defines the React Native module 'Fido2ApiModule' that interacts with the Android FIDO2 API to facilitate hardware security key authentication. It includes methods to prompt for U2F authentication, handle activity results, and manage FIDO2 requests and responses.

classes.name: Fido2ApiModule
classes.description: React Native module for interfacing with Android FIDO2 API for biometric and security key authentication.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the React Native module.

methods.name: promptForU2FAuthentication
methods.description: Prompts the user for U2F authentication using provided options in JSON format.

methods.description: Converts a base64url-encoded string to a byte array.
